scope: Public-page media audit plus official documentation review; no provider calls, translated playback acceptance, user credentials, DRM bypass, login, purchase or production runtime changes.
notes: All recorded attempts are retained, including source/initialization races and unsuccessful or interrupted checks. A schema1/2 pass is diagnostic and not final paused-PCM acceptance.

Only strictPcmCheckPassed with manual content-identity review is used for final media-read conclusions. This still does not establish translated speech, voice similarity, synchronization or continuous viewing.
Two old core checks were deliberately interrupted while the audit harness was corrected; they are marked and cannot be attributed to platform compatibility.
PageSignals are heuristic. Domestic manual review corrects the original Douyin SMS-code false positive. drmObserved is page-wide and not proof that the selected programme is protected.

Screenshots are local evidence under ignored output/playwright/ and are not bundled. Only public watch URLs and media hosts/types/status are retained; signed media URLs, headers, cookies and keys are omitted.
No site-wide pass percentage is computed: access-limited, document-only and short public media cases are not a common acceptance denominator.

manualGlobalReview.scope: Seven overseas platforms; nine public videos, early/late observation plus bounded diagnostics. This review separates visible player detection, candidate source discovery, a source eligible for selection, strict paused ahead PCM, and actual translated speech. No provider calls, account login, CAPTCHA solving, subscription or DRM bypass.

reports.purpose: Initial 18 cases; diagnostic only, superseded by strict checks where available
Strict schema 3 rechecks: Facebook early/late, TikTok early, Instagram late with correct 3s threshold, Twitch clip with 20s extra settle
Strict schema 3: four official Vimeo player-entry cases and TikTok extra-settle case
Strict schema 3: Curiosity official player with 20s extra settle and observed controls
Strict schema 3: initial selector attempt; no actual click was recorded
Strict schema 3: final after-settle selector attempt; visible wait timed out, no click performed

manualGlobalReview.actualTranslatedSpeech: Not tested in this audit. No new original-voice, synchronization, long-playback or language-quality acceptance claim. Historical 0.2.2 Bilibili provider tests are not a new 0.2.4 provider result.

findings.status: Watch-page access blocked; official-player metadata not ready
findings.details: Both watch URLs in early/late modes showed a Cloudflare human-verification page. Big Buck Bunny official-player early/late returned HTTP 401 with an explicit connection-security restriction. Curiosity official-player cases found a visible video and one HLS candidate, but duration remained non-finite, readyState 0 and source clock 0 even with extra 20s settle. Neither the initial nor final Play-selector attempt actually clicked: the first did not match; the final visible wait timed out. No PCM decoder failure has been established because decoding was never eligible.

findings.status: Headless player did not initialize; final visible check timed out during discovery
findings.details: Two public euronews videos in early/late modes loaded the correct title, description and transcript but had black player placeholders, no video/iframe and no media traffic. No explicit login, region or protection message was established. A separate visible-browser attempt reached a profile-cleanup ENOTEMPTY error before report persistence; it must not be counted as a platform, source or PCM failure. Root owns the final visible retry and its result, if produced, should be added separately.
findings.finalVisibleConclusion: The root visible retry returned HTTP 200 but reached its total audit deadline during discovery after 234.059 seconds. No PCM or site-wide compatibility result was obtained; the corrected audit retained the result and exited normally.

findings.status: Strict paused ahead PCM passed for one public clip after an extra 20s settle
findings.details: Manual review of initial screenshot 10 and final screenshot 05 confirmed the same ELEAGUE Week Two Group B / ELEAGUE TV Counter-Strike footage (G2 eSports vs Selfless), not a pre-roll. The clip duration was 32.038678s. Two windows (3-11s and 16.019339-24.019339s) each produced 128000 finite, non-silent PCM samples with correct coverage while the native clock stayed paused (2.019364 to 2.021835s). Initial early/late visits already found a direct file candidate but had non-finite duration, so they were not decode passes. VOD and live are not covered.

Both modes failed navigation with net::ERR_HTTP_RESPONSE_CODE_FAILURE and the extension then encountered a Chrome error page. No playable page, source or PCM was obtained. This is not evidence of complete extension incompatibility or a confirmed account/region restriction.

findings.status: Strict paused ahead PCM passed in both modes for the NASA Earth sample
findings.details: Manual screenshots confirmed the NASA Earth ORACLES footage with a 1:05 native duration, not an advertisement; measured duration was 65.301s. A login overlay remained present, but the publicly loaded native video could play, pause and expose its direct media source without login or dismissing the overlay. Both strict schema 3 visits passed front/middle windows (3-11s and 32.6505-40.6505s), each 128000 finite, non-silent samples, with correct timestamp coverage and non-mutating pause readback. Four strict windows passed in total.

findings.status: Player detection passed; source association was inconsistent and strict PCM was not reached
findings.details: The real Kellie Gerardi NASA Plant Lab Reel played in a blob-backed video, duration 13.366666s; a login overlay did not prevent the public video from loading. Early observation saw five file resources and the extension explicitly rejected ambiguous association. The initial late visit found one file source, but its 15s audit threshold incorrectly excluded this 13.37s clip; no PCM claim is made from that visit. The corrected strict late recheck with minDuration 3 still had no associated source (discovering), despite the native video having readyState 4 and advancing. This supports an unstable media-binding limitation for the sample, not blanket platform incompatibility.

findings.status: An initial ahead-decode success did not reproduce in strict final checks
findings.details: Initial early observation identified the correct Washington Post vaccine video (26.827585s), excluding the hidden 50x50 auxiliary 2s video, and produced two non-silent PCM windows under the older diagnostic method. Initial late observation had navigation timeout and no finite-duration selected source. Strict early recheck and a further 20s-settle recheck did not obtain an eligible extension player/source, while later native snapshots did show the same 26.827585s video at readyState 4. This is recorded as unstable discovery/binding; the legacy success is retained as diagnostic evidence and is not promoted to strict paused-PCM acceptance.

priorities: Keep ready candidate URL, finite player metadata, eligible main-player association and completed paused PCM as separate UI/report states.
For Instagram/TikTok, prioritize content-ID and audio-track association over choosing an arbitrary observed MP4; the recorded early/late differences need continuous identity-aware re-evaluation.
Treat native/player initialization waits and public access barriers as explicit conditions. Do not infer platform-wide compatibility from a single file source or one short video.
Persist audit progress/results before browser/profile cleanup; a cleanup exception must not erase compatibility evidence.
manualGlobalReview.stopBoundary: No more samples or retries by this agent. Root manages the final visible Dailymotion retry. No runtime, adapter, package, version, installation or release changes were made.

harnessFailures.conclusion: No reliable sample result was saved. The cleanup exception occurred before report persistence, so this is not evidence of platform incompatibility or PCM failure.

manualDomesticReview.scope: Manual interpretation of 8 domestic platforms / 10 actual public sample URLs. These are sample-specific anonymous observations, not platform-wide guarantees or translation/voice-quality acceptance.
protocolNotes: Initial 20 runs used the first audit protocol and remain diagnostic. All 4 cases with any successful PCM window were rerun under final auditSchemaVersion 3.
Final schema3 uses expectedDuration, finite PCM checks, a 60-second decode deadline and the same worker for both windows; native pause is observed after decoding without issuing pause first.
Early means observation lease was established before opening the page; late means the page was opened and playback attempted before observation began.
Absence of observed mediaKeys/encrypted events is not proof that every rendition or subscription programme is unprotected.
No model call, account login, subscription, payment, captcha solving, extension installation change or runtime modification was made.

platforms.anonymousAccess: The visible episode selector marked episodes 2–6 temporarily free during this assessment. The main timeline includes sponsored content; a separate 15-second advertisement was not counted as the episode.
platforms.finalAssessment: Early observation passed source selection and both paused PCM windows. Late observation was unstable: the initial diagnostic run passed, but final schema3 saw fragments only and did not obtain a playlist.

platforms.verifiedContent: 中国 第一季 第1集（春秋）
platforms.anonymousAccess: The actual main programme loaded anonymously. The HTML value 617 min is the album total and was not treated as episode duration.
platforms.finalAssessment: Early observation passed both paused finite-PCM windows. The opening window was legitimately silent and the middle window contained non-silent audio. Late observation was unstable: the initial run decoded only the opening window and timed out in the middle, while final schema3 saw fragments only.

platforms.verifiedContent: UGC: 如何10分钟做好一个图腾柱？ (62–63 seconds); VIP documentary: 舌尖上的中国 第一季 第1集 自然的馈赠 (page metadata 49:59)
platforms.finalAssessment: The UGC programme played and was detected, but initial early/late scans could not associate the multiple media resources. The normal-UI followup selected an HLS source but its first ahead-read returned HTTP 405; no PCM succeeded. The VIP documentary only exposed a short advertisement or a failed native media element, so its actual programme remains unverified.
platforms.accessNotes: Both pages contained a browser/1080P support notice. The visible normal 'continue with current browser' selector was found but the click timed out; no forced click was used. VIP status and the browser notice are not proof of DRM.

platforms.verifiedContent: 金牌调解2025：20251229 被“赌”掉的人生
platforms.finalAssessment: After waiting an additional 65 seconds for the advertisement to end naturally, the actual programme was playing at 38.9 seconds with readyState 4 and no media error. The extension detected the programme but could not associate the 10 file resources with its audio; no ahead PCM was obtained.
platforms.accessNotes: The initial short 15-second video was an advertisement, not programme duration. No paid advertisement skipping or login was used.

platforms.expectedContent: 人生七年 第一季 (HTML metadata 2332 seconds, isVip=false); 胖小唯的科普乐园 第1集 (HTML metadata 144.4 seconds)
platforms.finalAssessment: All early/late attempts navigated to the platform's /_____tmd_____/punish verification page. Actual video, source selection and ahead PCM remain unverified; this is not evidence of extension incompatibility or DRM.

platforms.verifiedContent: 李永乐老师：天空为什么是蓝的？第一个科普视频重制版 (landing-page title only)
platforms.finalAssessment: Both attempts displayed an app-opening landing page with 'open the app to see full content', and no native video element. Actual browser playback and ahead decoding remain unverified, rather than being counted as a platform failure.

platforms.verifiedContent: 光头强老师：物理实验不要太直观了吧！会不会影响孩子们的想象力？
platforms.finalAssessment: The specified short video was detected and playing behind an anonymous login dialog. Early observation could not associate three file resources; late observation found no source. Ahead PCM was not obtained, and authenticated playback was not evaluated.
platforms.accessNotes: The original diagnostic's automation-check signal matching 'verification code' is a false positive: screenshots show the SMS login field, not a captcha challenge. No login or captcha interaction was performed.

platforms.expectedContent: Real photo ID obtained from the official brilliant-page SSR hot-rank entry labelled 土豆皮炸制黄金大饺子; the actual video title was not verified.
platforms.finalAssessment: Both detail-page attempts returned only a JSON result:2 response with no player. The reason is not established; classify as anonymous access unverified, not as DRM or extension incompatibility.
